inputs.text: Phoenix’s city council approved a plan Wednesday night barring ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property. It’s a necessary stand: public resources shouldn’t help expand a system that leaves immigrant communities living with fear and unequal power. But this boundary is not justice or due process. Real protection means changing the structures that make immigrants vulnerable, not just restricting where enforcement can operate.
